spec.description: Upgrades SeaDex recommends for your anime library with the storage they need, findings to check by hand, and how your library compares with SeaDex. Tiles at the top of the Overview appear only while seadex-scout needs attention.

spec.title: Upgrades
spec.description: The upgrades SeaDex recommends for what you have, after your filters. It turns blue from 1 to show there is something to grab, not a fault. Upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt count only when you pick Show under Optional upgrades. Unknown means no check has counted the upgrades in the last 2 hours, as before the first check after a start.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", upgrades="upgrades" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | unwrap upgrades [2h]) by ()

spec.title: Upgrades available
spec.description: Up to 200 upgrades SeaDex recommends for your library, newer versions of a group you have first, then by size change, from most added to most freed. The title opens Sonarr or Radarr, and the Upgrades tile above counts every upgrade. Size is the download and Size change what your library gains, or frees when negative, with - for an unknown size. First seen is when seadex-scout first saw the upgrade since it started, and No upgrades available means SeaDex lists nothing better than what you have.

spec.expr: {container="$container"} |= `findings reported` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id" | msg=`findings reported` | keep pass_id

{container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id", rank_alt="rank_alt", rank_none="rank_none", title="title", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", arr_url="arr_url", season="season", status="status", current_tier="current_tier", current_group="current_group", current_revision="current_revision", recommended_group="recommended_group", recommended_revision="recommended_revision", alt_groups="alt_groups", nyaa_url="nyaa_url", ab_url="ab_url", public_url="public_url", first_seen="first_seen", recommended_bytes="recommended_bytes", size_change_bytes="size_change_bytes" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" | rank_$optional > 0 | rank_$optional <= 200 | label_format why=`{{ if eq .status "newer_revision" }}{{ .recommended_revision }} available{{ else if eq .current_tier "alt" }}SeaDex alt{{ else if eq .current_tier "unlisted" }}Neither best nor alt{{ else }}Better release{{ end }}`, current_group=`{{ .current_group | replace "," ", " }}{{ if .current_revision }} {{ .current_revision }}{{ end }}`, best=`{{ .recommended_group }}{{ if .recommended_revision }} {{ .recommended_revision }}{{ end }}`, alt=`{{ if .alt_groups }}{{ .alt_groups | replace "," ", " }}{{ else }}-{{ end }}`, rank=`{{ .rank_$optional }}` | drop nyaa_url="", ab_url="", public_url="", current_revision="", recommended_revision="", alt_groups=""

spec.title: Check by hand
spec.description: Findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own, up to 100, and the To check by hand tile above counts them all. Several groups on disk means your files mix release groups, and Untagged release means your file or SeaDex's release names no group. Open the title and compare it with SeaDex yourself. Nothing to check means every finding was decided.

spec.expr: {container="$container"} |= `findings reported` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id" | msg=`findings reported` | keep pass_id

{container="$container"} |= `manual review` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id", rank_check="rank_check", title="title", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", arr_url="arr_url", season="season", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group" | msg=~`series spans multiple release groups, manual review|release group unverifiable, manual review` | rank_check > 0 | rank_check <= 100 | label_format current_group=`{{ replace "," ", " .current_group }}`

spec.title: Library overview
spec.description: SeaDex entries in your library, one per season, film or special SeaDex lists and once per copy when Sonarr and Radarr both hold it, grouped by what you have. Season not found means seadex-scout found no files for that season, because they are missing or Sonarr numbers that season differently, for example under specials. Episode not known means seadex-scout does not compare a film or special in Sonarr's specials, because the anime ID map does not tie it to a listed episode or the specials could not be read. No summary yet means no daily library summary has arrived in the last 26 hours.

spec.expr: max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_best="have_best" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_best [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_alt="have_alt" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_alt [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_older_revision="have_older_revision" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_older_revision [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", have_unlisted="have_unlisted" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap have_unlisted [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", no_file="no_file" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap no_file [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unverified="unverified" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unverified [26h]) by ())
max(last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `library summary` | json msg="msg", unattributed="unattributed" | msg=`library summary` | unwrap unattributed [26h]) by ())

spec.title: Errors logged
spec.description: Each error logged in this time range, with how often it was logged. An error at SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map needs nothing from you. On the Overview, Errors in this range counts the errors with no Problem, and Library problem and Upstream outage show a Problem logged in the last hour. Checks that stopped log no error, so the Overview shows them as Last check or Last full check.

spec.expr: sum by (condition, arr, msg) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", arr="arr", msg="msg" | level=`ERROR` | label_format msg=`{{ if .condition }}{{ else }}{{ .msg }}{{ end }}` [$__range]))

seadex-window-oversize.text: Too many SeaDex changes to fetch

spec.title: Feed reads per tracker per day
spec.description: How many times Sonarr and Radarr read the Torznab feed each day, per tracker. A steady daily total is normal. A tracker whose bars drop to nothing was turned off or marked failing in Sonarr or Radarr, and no bars at all means the feed is not set up.

spec.expr: sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`true` [$__interval]))

defaults.noValue: No feed reads in this range

spec.title: Storage needed
spec.description: The space to download every upgrade the Optional upgrades switch shows, each torrent counted once, including any beyond the 200 rows Upgrades available lists. It says at least because an upgrade whose download size is unknown adds nothing, and Upgrades not in the size totals, below, counts those upgrades. No sizes yet means no check has run since seadex-scout started.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", download_bytes_total="download_bytes_total" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | unwrap download_bytes_total [2h]) by ()

spec.title: Biggest size changes
spec.description: The 25 upgrades that change your library's size the most, growing or shrinking, for the upgrades the Optional upgrades switch shows. Size change is the download minus the files it replaces, so a negative one frees space. An upgrade without a known size is left out. No upgrade with a size means none of the current upgrades has both sizes known.

spec.expr: {container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id", hidden_tier="hidden_tier" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | keep pass_id

{container="$container"} |= `biggest upgrade` | json msg="msg", pass_id="pass_id", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", rank="rank", current_tier="current_tier", title="title", al_id="al_id", arr="arr", arr_url="arr_url", season="season", current_group="current_group", recommended_group="recommended_group", recommended_bytes="recommended_bytes", current_bytes="current_bytes", size_change_bytes="size_change_bytes" | msg=`biggest upgrade` | hidden_tier="$optional" | current_tier != "$optional"

spec.title: Upgrades by format and resolution
spec.description: The kind and resolution of the releases SeaDex recommends now, for the upgrades the Optional upgrades switch shows. It is the average number of upgrades per check over the last two hours, whatever time range you pick, so it shows the current list like the Upgrades tile. A remux is a disc copy, the largest kind, and an encode is compressed. A value between whole numbers means the list changed in those two hours, and No upgrades means the list is empty.

spec.expr: sum by (kind, resolution) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `better release available` | json msg="msg", current_tier="current_tier", kind="kind", resolution="resolution" | msg=`better release available` | current_tier != "$optional" [2h])) / on () group_left sum by () (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `findings reported` | json msg="msg" | msg=`findings reported` [2h]))

spec.title: Full check duration per day
spec.description: How long the longest full check took each day. A full check reads the whole SeaDex list and your library once a day, and a growing bar means your library or SeaDex grew, or an upstream got slow. A day with no bar had no finished full check, and after 72 hours without one the Overview shows Last full check.

spec.expr: max_over_time({container="$container"} |= `cycle ` | json msg="msg", duration="duration" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded` | duration != "" | unwrap duration_seconds(duration) [$__interval]) by ()

defaults.noValue: No full check in this range

spec.title: Degraded checks by reason
spec.description: Checks in this time range that finished without doing their whole job, by reason, with how many times. A full check runs once a day and a quick check every poll interval. One degraded check now and then is normal, and the same reason every check is worth fixing. No degraded checks means every check finished its job.

spec.expr: sum by (msg, reason) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `degraded` | json msg="msg", reason="reason" | msg=~`cycle degraded|tick degraded` [$__range]))

mapping-stale.text: Anime ID map out of date

awaiting-first-reconcile.text: Waiting for the first full check

window-oversize.text: Too many SeaDex changes to fetch

spec.title: Searches per tracker per day
spec.description: How many searches Sonarr and Radarr sent through the Torznab feed each day, per tracker. Searches come when you search by hand or the arr looks for a missing season. No searches in this range is normal when the feed is not set up or nothing was searched.

spec.expr: sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed", t="t", curated="curated", returned="returned" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`false` | t=~`search|tvsearch|movie` [$__interval]))

spec.title: Curated search results per day
spec.description: How many search results each day were releases SeaDex curates, the only ones the feed passes back to Sonarr and Radarr, per tracker. Searches that keep finding none mean SeaDex lists nothing for what was searched. No results in this range means no search returned a curated release.

spec.expr: sum by (scope) (sum_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed", t="t", curated="curated", returned="returned" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`false` | t=~`search|tvsearch|movie` | unwrap curated [$__interval]))

spec.title: Releases in the RSS feed
spec.description: How many releases each tracker's RSS feed offers Sonarr and Radarr, at its largest in each hour. It grows as SeaDex curates new releases and shrinks as old ones age out. No feed in this range means the Torznab feed is not set up.

spec.expr: max_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer feed snapshot written` | json msg="msg", nyaa_feed="nyaa_feed" | msg=`indexer feed snapshot written` | unwrap nyaa_feed [$__interval]) by ()
max_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer feed snapshot written` | json msg="msg", ab_feed="ab_feed" | msg=`indexer feed snapshot written` | unwrap ab_feed [$__interval]) by ()

spec.title: AnimeBytes feed
spec.description: Shown only when the last feed update held AnimeBytes releases back from the RSS feed, because indexer.ab_passkey is not set and no download link can be built. Set the passkey to offer them. No shipped alert rule watches this.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer feed snapshot written` | json msg="msg", ab_releases_skipped="ab_releases_skipped" | msg=`indexer feed snapshot written` | unwrap ab_releases_skipped [2h]) by () > 0

spec.title: To check by hand
spec.description: The findings seadex-scout could not decide on its own, listed in Check by hand below. It turns yellow from 1 because each one waits for you to look. Unknown means no check has counted the findings to check in the last 2 hours, as before the first check after a start.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `findings reported` | json msg="msg", manual_review="manual_review" | msg=`findings reported` | unwrap manual_review [2h]) by ()

spec.title: Library growth, sized upgrades
spec.description: How much your library grows, or shrinks when negative, once every upgrade the Optional upgrades switch shows replaces the files it covers. It adds only upgrades whose download and replaced files both have a known size, so the true change can be larger or smaller. No sizes yet means no check has run since seadex-scout started.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", size_change_bytes="size_change_bytes" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | unwrap size_change_bytes [2h]) by ()

spec.title: Upgrades not in the size totals
spec.description: Upgrades the Optional upgrades switch shows that a size total leaves out, because a size it needs is unknown. Storage needed needs the download size, and Library growth also needs the size of the files the download replaces, so its count is usually the larger. A torrent or file that two upgrades list with different sizes is left out too, and the monitoring docs list why a size stays unknown.

spec.expr: last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", upgrades_download_unsized="upgrades_download_unsized" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | unwrap upgrades_download_unsized [2h]) by ()

last_over_time({container="$container"} |= `upgrade sizes` | json msg="msg", hidden_tier="hidden_tier", upgrades_unsized="upgrades_unsized" | msg=`upgrade sizes` | hidden_tier="$optional" | unwrap upgrades_unsized [2h]) by ()

spec.title: Last check
spec.description: Shown only when seadex-scout has logged no check of any kind in the last 3 hours, so the upgrades and the Torznab feed stop updating. The SeadexScoutScanStalled alert reads the same lines and fires 15 minutes later. Rule out a stopped container or log collector, then restart seadex-scout.

spec.expr: absent_over_time({container="$container"} | json msg="msg" | msg=~`cycle complete|cycle degraded|tick complete|tick degraded|reconcile started` [3h])

spec.title: Last full check
spec.description: Shown only when no daily full check has finished in 72 hours, so releases SeaDex removed or edited are missed. The SeadexScoutReconcileStalled alert reads the same lines. Look for degraded checks or errors on the Scout health tab.

spec.expr: absent_over_time({container="$container"} |= `reconcile complete` | json msg="msg" | msg=`reconcile complete` [72h])

spec.title: Errors in this range
spec.description: Shown only when seadex-scout logged an error you can fix in this time range, usually a failed Sonarr or Radarr library read. The SeadexScoutCycleError alert fires on the same lines within the hour. The Errors logged table on the Scout health tab names each one.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition=`` [$__range])) > 0

spec.title: Library problem
spec.description: Shown only while Sonarr or Radarr keeps returning a library under half its earlier size, or Sonarr keeps failing to list the episodes of some series. Those shows keep their old findings. The tile names the app, the one logged most if both have a problem, and Errors logged on the Scout health tab lists each problem. The SeadexScoutLibraryDegraded alert reads the same lines, and the monitoring docs say what to check.

spec.expr: topk(1, sum by (arr) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition", arr="arr" | level=`ERROR` | condition=~`library-walk-shrunk|library-walk-partial` | label_format arr=`{{ if .arr }}{{ .arr }}{{ else }}sonarr{{ end }}` [1h]))) > 0

spec.title: Feed not read
spec.description: Shown when Sonarr or Radarr read this tracker's RSS feed in the last week but not in the last 6 hours, so new releases stop reaching them. If both trackers stopped, the tile names one and the Feed reads chart on the Scout health tab shows both. The SeadexScoutFeedNotPolled alert reads the same lines over the same week, whatever time range you pick. Check whether that indexer is disabled or failing in your apps.

spec.expr:
topk(1,
sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`true` [7d]))
unless
sum by (scope) (count_over_time({container="$container"} |= `indexer request` | json msg="msg", scope="scope", feed="feed" | msg=`indexer request` | feed=`true` [6h]))
)

spec.title: Upstream outage
spec.description: Shown only while SeaDex, AniList or the anime ID map keeps failing, which needs nothing from you. seadex-scout keeps its findings and the feed until it recovers. The tile names the failing service, the one logged most if several fail, and Errors logged on the Scout health tab lists each. The SeadexScoutUpstreamUnavailable alert reads the same lines.

spec.expr: topk(1, sum by (condition) (count_over_time({container="$container"} | json level="level", condition="condition" | level=`ERROR` | condition=~`seadex-unreachable|seadex-catalogue-fetch-failing|seadex-window-oversize|anilist-lookups-failing|mapping-refresh-rejected` [1h]))) > 0

spec.title: SeaDex Scout

spec.name: container
spec.label: Container
spec.description: The value of the container label your log collector puts on seadex-scout's lines.

spec.name: optional
spec.label: Optional upgrades
spec.description: Hide leaves out upgrades where you already have a SeaDex alt. Show lists them too.
